import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
from imblearn.over_sampling import ADASYN, SMOTE
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification

# Create imbalanced dataset
X, y = make_classification(n_samples=500, n_features=4, n_informative=3,
                           weights=[0.85, 0.15], random_state=42)

# Check class distribution before ADASYN
print("Class distribution BEFORE:")
print(Counter(y))
print(f"Dataset shape: {X.shape}")

# Apply ADASYN
adasyn = ADASYN(random_state=42)
X_adasyn, y_adasyn = adasyn.fit_resample(X, y)

# Compare with SMOTE
smote = SMOTE(random_state=42)
X_smote, y_smote = smote.fit_resample(X, y)

# Check class distribution after ADASYN
print("\nClass distribution AFTER ADASYN:")
print(Counter(y_adasyn))
print(f"ADASYN shape: {X_adasyn.shape}")

print("\nClass distribution AFTER SMOTE:")
print(Counter(y_smote))
print(f"SMOTE shape: {X_smote.shape}")

print(f"\nADASYN generated {len(X_adasyn) - len(X)} samples")
print(f"SMOTE generated {len(X_smote) - len(X)} samples")
